🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, indicating Internal Rotation; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication). Mixed sector performance and major divergence across key stocks support a neutral reading, not a directional regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads (+6.81% 1W), with CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%) and CMCSA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.03% | 1M: +19.15%). Consumer Staples (+3.89%) and Consumer Discretionary (+3.21%) follow; WMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +18.08%) and HD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.37% | 1M: +22.46%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest (-11.89% 1W; -14.09% 1M), with INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -43.25% | 1M: -53.81%) and ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -19.49%). Energy (-10.19% 1W) and Industrials (-2.71%) also lag; XOM is CORRECTION (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +0.76%) and CAT is BELOW TREND (1W: -14.48% | 1M: -31.81%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%), BKNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), CMCSA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.03% | 1M: +19.15%), TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +4.58%), and LOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.63% | 1M: +25.97%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication); gains are concentrated in Communication and Consumer Discretionary.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -43.25% | 1M: -53.81%), AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -28.60% | 1M: -37.39%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -27.20% | 1M: -43.80%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -24.29% | 1M: -38.68%), and PLTR BELOW TREND (1W: -21.09% | 1M: -20.16%). Weakness is concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%) and BKNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%). TMUS is in RECOVERY (1W: +9.03% | 1M: -4.21%); major divergence across key stocks means watch for trend breaks rather than treating short-term moves as confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Severe weakness: sector return is -11.89% 1W and -14.09% 1M. NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -23.53%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -19.38%), and META BELOW TREND (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -16.11%); MSFT is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +1.16%), while AAPL is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +2.23%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed: the sector is down 0.45% 1W but up 4.45% 1M. V is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +13.57%) and MA is ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.18% | 1M: +15.24%), while JPM is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.82% | 1M: +2.35%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is modestly positive at +0.46% 1W and +9.31% 1M, with mixed short-term signals. ABT is ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +15.77%), while JNJ is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +5.37%) and UNH is in CORRECTION (1W: -3.70% | 1M: +5.25%).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare strength while reducing exposure to persistently weak Technology names; style is mixed, with no confirmed Growth or Value leadership. HD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.37% | 1M: +22.46%) and ABT ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +15.77%) contrast with NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -23.53%); major divergence argues for measured positioning.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: HD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.37% | 1M: +22.46%) and WMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +18.08%) if gains hold; both have positive 1W and 1M trends. BEARISH: INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -43.25% | 1M: -53.81%) and ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -19.49%) unless selling pressure eases.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+6.81% 1W) and Consumer Staples (+3.89%) lead the 6/11 positive sectors, though leadership is narrow. BEARISH: Technology (-11.89% 1W; -14.09% 1M) and Energy (-10.19% 1W) remain weakest.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price-level data was not provided. Watch whether MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +1.16%) holds positive returns across both periods, whether AAPL in CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +2.23%) returns to positive weekly momentum, and whether NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -15.01% | 1M: -23.53%) stabilizes.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+75): FDA accelerated approval for a head-and-neck cancer drug; JNJ is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +5.37%), so the positive catalyst diverges from near-term price action. The other highest positive-sentiment names lack supplied return data for a price-action cross-check.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CHTR (-45): Q3 loss; despite the headline, CHTR is ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.47% | 1M: +17.67%), a clear sentiment-price divergence. TTWO (-45): price-target cut, while TTWO is ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +4.58%); PFE (-45) is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +6.71%) and UNH (-35) is in CORRECTION (1W: -3.70% | 1M: +5.25%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with Internal Rotation and Narrow leadership (3/5 Communication); style is mixed / no clear leadership. HD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.37% | 1M: +22.46%) and ABT ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +15.77%) show relative strength. Major divergence warrants monitoring: JNJ’s positive FDA news contrasts with CORRECTION (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +5.37%), while Technology remains broadly weak.
